prompt: What is the basic structure of an HTML5 document?
response:
```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Document</title>
</head>
<body>
    <!-- Content goes here -->
</body>
</html>
```

prompt: How do I link an external CSS file to an HTML document?
response: You use the `<link>` tag within the `<head>` section: `<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">`

prompt: What is the purpose of the `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">` tag?
response: This meta tag is crucial for responsive web design. It tells the browser to set the viewport width to the device width and to set the initial zoom level to 1.0 when the page is first loaded.

prompt: What is the difference between `<div>` and `<span>`?
response: `<div>` is a block-level element, meaning it takes up the full width available and starts on a new line. `<span>` is an inline-level element, meaning it only takes up as much width as necessary and does not start on a new line.

prompt: What are semantic HTML tags? Provide examples.
response: Semantic HTML tags describe the meaning of the content they contain, making the HTML more readable and accessible. Examples include `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<article>`, `<section>`, `<aside>`, `<footer>`.

prompt: How do I create a hyperlink in HTML?

prompt: What is the purpose of the `alt` attribute in the `` tag?
response: The `alt` attribute provides alternative text for an image if the image cannot be displayed. It's crucial for accessibility, as screen readers use it to describe images to visually impaired users.

prompt: How do I create a basic HTML table?
response:
```html
Header 1 Header 2
Data 1 Data 2
```

prompt: Explain the difference between `id` and `class` attributes in HTML.
response: An `id` attribute must be unique within an HTML document and is used to identify a single element. A `class` attribute can be used by multiple elements, allowing you to apply the same styles or behaviors to a group of elements.

prompt: How do I include a JavaScript file in an HTML document?
response: You use the `<script>` tag, typically placed just before the closing `</body>` tag for performance reasons: `<script src="script.js"></script>`. You can also add the `defer` attribute: `<script src="script.js" defer></script>`.

prompt: What is the `<form>` tag used for?
response: The `<form>` tag is used to create an HTML form for user input. It can contain various input elements like text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, submit buttons, etc.

prompt: How do I create a button in HTML?
response: You can use the `<button>` tag: `<button type="button">Click Me</button>` or an input of type submit: `<input type="submit" value="Submit">`

prompt: What is the purpose of the `<!DOCTYPE html>` declaration?
response: It's a document type declaration that tells the web browser which version of HTML the page is written in. For HTML5, it ensures the browser renders the page in "standards mode" rather than "quirks mode".

prompt: How can I add comments in HTML?
response: HTML comments start with `<!--` and end with `-->`: `<!-- This is an HTML comment -->`

prompt: What is the `<head>` section used for in HTML?
response: The `<head>` section contains meta-information about the HTML document, such as its title, links to stylesheets, script files, and other metadata that is not displayed directly on the web page.

prompt: How do I create a dropdown list (select box) in HTML?
response:
```html
<select name="fruits" id="fruits">
  <option value="apple">Apple</option>
  <option value="banana">Banana</option>
  <option value="orange">Orange</option>
</select>
```

prompt: What is the `placeholder` attribute in an input field?
response: The `placeholder` attribute provides a hint to the user about what kind of information is expected in the input field. The hint is displayed in the input field before the user enters a value.

prompt: What is the purpose of the `lang` attribute in the `<html>` tag?
response: The `lang` attribute specifies the primary language of the document. This is important for accessibility (screen readers), search engines, and browser rendering.

prompt: What is the difference between `<ol>` and `<ul>`?
response: `<ol>` creates an ordered list (numbered items), while `<ul>` creates an unordered list (bulleted items).

prompt: How do I add a favicon to my HTML page?
response: You add a `<link>` tag in the `<head>` section: `<link rel="icon" type="image/x-icon" href="/images/favicon.ico">`

prompt: What is the `target="_blank"` attribute used for in an anchor tag?
response: It specifies that the linked document will open in a new window or tab.
